Offcanvas

Offcanvas panels slide in from any edge of the viewport to host filters, navigation or secondary content. Lighter-weight than a modal and wider than a drawer when needed.

Basic Offcanvas

Wrap content in .zak-offcanvas with a .zak-offcanvas-surface panel. Position the panel with surface variants and toggle from a trigger using data-zak-offcanvas="#id".

Start Panel

A panel entering from the left edge.

End Panel

A panel entering from the right edge.

Top Panel

A panel dropping in from the top.

Bottom Panel

A panel rising in from the bottom.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-offcanvas="#offStart">Start</button>

<div class="zak-offcanvas" id="offStart">
    <aside class="zak-offcanvas-surface zak-offcanvas-surface-start">
        <header class="zak-offcanvas-header">
            <h3 style="margin:0; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600;">Start Panel</h3>
            <button type="button" class="zak-modal-close" data-zak-offcanvas-close aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
        </header>
        <div class="zak-offcanvas-body">...</div>
    </aside>
</div>

Offcanvas with Header

Use .zak-offcanvas-header for a title row with a close button. The header stays fixed while the body scrolls independently.

Full Width Offcanvas

Override the surface width to create a near-full-screen panel, like a mobile settings sheet.

Settings

Offcanvas with Overlay

Like drawers, offcanvas panels show a scrim by default. Clicking the backdrop or pressing Escape closes the panel.

Notifications

Dim everything behind the panel so the user stays focused on the offcanvas content.

Offcanvas with Close Button

Every panel can carry an explicit dismiss control. Outside clicks and Escape also close the panel.

Menu

Custom close icon. The data-zak-offcanvas-close attribute closes the nearest panel.

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-offcanvas               /* Wrapper (hidden until active) */
.zak-offcanvas-active        /* Added by JS to slide the panel in */
.zak-offcanvas-overlay       /* JS-created scrim */
.zak-offcanvas-surface       /* The sliding panel */
.zak-offcanvas-surface-start /* Left edge  (width 20rem) */
.zak-offcanvas-surface-end   /* Right edge (width 20rem) */
.zak-offcanvas-surface-top   /* Top edge   (height 16rem) */
.zak-offcanvas-surface-bottom/* Bottom edge (min-height 16rem) */
.zak-offcanvas-header        /* Fixed title row */
.zak-offcanvas-body          /* Scrollable content */
.zak-offcanvas-footer        /* Action row */

/* Variables used */
--zak-z-modal                /* Panel z-index */
--zak-z-backdrop             /* Overlay z-index */
--zak-backdrop-bg            /* Scrim color */
--zak-shadow-xl              /* Panel shadow */
--zak-transition-slow        /* Slide duration */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-offcanvas="#id"    open the panel
//   data-zak-offcanvas-close    close the closest .zak-offcanvas

// Programmatic API
zak.offcanvas.open('#myPanel');
zak.offcanvas.close('#myPanel');
zak.offcanvas.toggle('#myPanel');

// Events fire on the offcanvas element:
panel.addEventListener('zak:open', function () { console.log('opened'); });
panel.addEventListener('zak:close', function () { console.log('closed'); });

// Options
zak.offcanvas.open('#myPanel', {
    backdrop: true,   // show scrim (default true)
    closable: true    // allow Escape / outside click (default true)
});

Accessibility

  • Add a heading in .zak-offcanvas-header to name the panel for screen readers.
  • Give the dismiss button an aria-label="Close" and keep it reachable on the tab order.
  • Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
  • Press Escape to dismiss; the backdrop is clickable too.
  • The panel uses the dialog role semantics; add aria-modal="true" when a scrim is shown.
